name: laight
description: laight plugins for Claude Code, by Bernat Ferrer: baton (session handoff) and cross (two-reviewer PR review).

plugins.name: baton
plugins.description: A relay-race handoff between Claude Code sessions: baton.md written at every commit, verified at the next session's start.

plugins.name: cross
plugins.description: Two independent code reviewers, one merged and verified GitHub review, answered in the session that wrote the code.
